branches.conclusion: BiGSEM explicitly offers the structured doctoral programme Economics and Management with Economics, Finance, Management and Data Science profiles. The Management profile establishes doctoral thesis supervision and research activities, but the pages read do not establish an exact academic doctoral award or an explicit Operations research-field mapping.
The official faculty directory includes Mathematics and Technology. Their doctoral inventories and relevant research-field mappings remain unexamined; no absence of relevant provision is inferred.
